pr.title: [auto-fix] Restore correct hexadecimal digit conversion
pr.description:
The regression changes the adjustment for alphabetic hex digits from 9 to 8. That shifts A–F and a–f down by one, corrupting decoded bytes and Unicode values and causing the reported unescape failures. Restoring the original adjustment fixes the shared decoding path.

Reproduced failing tests:
- `CEscape.EscapeAndUnescape`
- `Unescape.BasicFunction`
- `CUnescapeTest.UnescapesMultipleHexNulls`

Original TeamCity revision: `ea5961e450e6c75bea69dd1dad49d8b90aa411d6`
